description: This file defines the SkillAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing 'Skill' entities within an HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations—creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting skills—along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation. The class interacts with a SkillService for business logic and uses various models and DTOs for data exchange. It is part of the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system, specifically within the admin API plugin context.

classes.name: SkillAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing skills, providing CRUD operations, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of SkillService used for skill-related business logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single skill by ID, throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of skills based on search filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing skills, including optional search filters and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new skill entity and persists it.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a skill, including required name and optional description.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for 'name' and 'description' fields for create/update operations, including length and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing skill identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a skill, including skipping the current entity for unique validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple skills by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, requiring an array of integer IDs.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Populates a Skill entity with data from request parameters and persists it via the service.
